title: The Sky Ships
content: I've been going to the mall world for a very long time. Though I only found this sub in the past 3 or so years. Sometimes I'm able to leave the mall proper. Been though the "terminal." Been in the office spaces. Flooded bathrooms. Deep parking garages. Been to the hotel/resort, and beyond on the beach. One thing that's reoccurring when I'm able to get "outside" are large ships in the sky. I call them ships because they're not UFOs or flying saucers in the classical sense. They are very large craft and most often you can only see a part of them as they emerge from cloud banks. You typically don't see the whole craft, but you know it's huge and you're seeing only part of it. It's as if they're up there hiding. But hiding in a way where they want to be seen. Teasing? They have an ethereal quality, and can be partially transparent at times. A few times I've seen them in their entirety, and they were quite large and moving either toward me, or away, always heading to the horizon. But that's rare. Mostly they are up there and peeking out. They never seem to look the same either. Sometimes long, cylindrical and rocket like, Buck Rodgers style. Other times more geometric, like large rectangles or many rectangles attached to one another. But always teasing, and rarely seen in their entirety. Has anyone ever been outside the Mall and looked up? Have you seen the sky ships hiding in the clouds?
